title: Electric Flagship SUV Surface Study
short_summary: A mock digest item highlighting a flagship SUV concept that uses calm surfacing, a low graphic beltline, and a full-width lamp signature to communicate quiet electric confidence.
design_observations: The body side avoids heavy character lines and relies on light catchers above the rocker to reduce visual mass.
A dark floating roof graphic visually lowers the greenhouse while preserving SUV presence.
The front mask removes traditional grille cues and shifts brand recognition toward lighting and badge placement.

title: Compact Urban EV Model Card
short_summary: A small city EV study focused on friendly proportions, protective corner graphics, and cabin-forward packaging for dense urban mobility.
design_observations: The short overhangs and tall cabin maximize perceived interior room within a compact footprint.
Rounded lamp modules and a soft bumper section reduce visual aggression and make the vehicle approachable.
Contrast-color corner blocks communicate durability and simplify repair-zone storytelling.

title: Heritage Performance Coupe Language
short_summary: A coupe language study balancing heritage cues with modern aero details, including a pronounced dash-to-axle ratio and precision-cut vents.
design_observations: The long hood and rear-set cabin create a classic performance proportion before any detail is added.
Technical vent inserts modernize the heritage silhouette without overwhelming the primary volume.
Rear haunch emphasis gives the car a planted stance and a clear powertrain narrative.

title: Luxury Sedan Interior Material Direction
short_summary: A mock source entry describing a minimalist luxury sedan interior that uses layered textiles, indirect lighting, and tactile controls to avoid screen-only interaction.
design_observations: Soft horizontal layering makes the IP feel wider and calmer while hiding technical seams.
Physical controls are reserved for high-frequency interactions, reinforcing a premium usability story.
The CMF palette favors low-gloss finishes to reduce glare and improve perceived refinement.

title: Adventure Pickup Graphic Strategy
short_summary: A rugged pickup study using modular graphics, exposed tow elements, and squared wheel arches to express utility without excessive decoration.
design_observations: Squared wheel openings frame the tire as a functional object and strengthen off-road credibility.
Graphic modules align with replaceable body zones, suggesting durability and customization.
The upper body remains relatively clean so functional details carry the rugged message.
